description: The pie chart, titled "Token Routing Distribution (FedHLM)," illustrates the proportion of different token routing strategies used in a federated learning system. The chart is divided into three distinct segments, each representing a different routing method. The largest segment, colored green, corresponds to the "LOCAL" strategy, which accounts for 94.5% of the total distribution. The second segment, colored red, represents the "LLM" strategy, making up 3.9% of the distribution. The smallest segment, colored blue, corresponds to the "EDGE_P2P" strategy, which constitutes 1.6% of the total. The segments are arranged in a clockwise direction, with the "LOCAL" segment occupying the majority of the pie, followed by "LLM," and then "EDGE_P2P." The percentages are clearly labeled within each segment, and the chart uses a simple color scheme to differentiate between the three categories.
